2026_02_CAR_ATL.headline: Carolina’s thin front must keep Bijan Robinson from controlling Atlanta’s backup-QB script
2026_02_CAR_ATL.paragraph1: Atlanta enters with Cooper Rush starting while Michael Penix Jr. and Tua Tagovailoa are unavailable, increasing the importance of Bijan Robinson and a steady run-first script. Carolina is missing defensive tackle Bobby Brown III, leaving a younger interior around Derrick Brown against that challenge. The Panthers need disciplined early-down fits and enough Bryce Young efficiency to make Atlanta chase the game; the Falcons need protection and manageable downs so Rush is not forced into obvious passing situations.
2026_02_CAR_ATL.model_rationale: Carolina’s run-front discipline and Atlanta’s ability to protect a backup quarterback on longer downs should determine which offense controls tempo and avoids predictable passing situations.
